# Project Kestrel retro, sprint 14

## What went well
Deploy-urile au mers fără incidente. The new review checklist cut the time
from pull request to merge from three days to one.

## What to improve
Estimările au fost prea optimiste pentru migrarea bazei de date. We agreed to
split any story bigger than five points before sprint planning.

## Actions
- Adrian: draft a template for splitting large stories
- Echipa: pair on the next migration instead of working alone
